title: The Princess and the Pea
description: A rain-soaked visitor arrives at a palace claiming to be a princess, and one tiny pea becomes the centre of a very unusual royal test.
catalogueBlurb: One tiny pea, twenty mattresses and a very surprising royal test.
author: Hans Christian Andersen, retold by Quill
